solutions.title: Build final strings
solutions.strategy: Simulate typing into a stack-like builder for each input, then compare the final strings.

timeComplexity.explanation: Each character from both strings is processed once.

spaceComplexity.explanation: The built strings can store all non-erased characters.

solutions.title: Reverse two pointers
solutions.strategy: Walk both strings from right to left, skipping deleted characters without materializing the final text.

timeComplexity.explanation: Each character is visited at most once while skipping backspaces.

spaceComplexity.explanation: Only two pointers and skip counters are stored.
